body.$description: The desk: the page under every window. Light: a warm light grey desk, the counterpart of the black desk. Windows, menu bar and dock are lighter than it, as they are lighter than the black desk in dark. The grain sits over it (palette.site.grain-opacity, inverted by the Window recipe). Proposed, Desk Light.

surface.$description: Window content fill, inputs, cards. Light: white, the brightest backdrop glass is tested over. Proposed, Desk Light.

surface-2.$description: Secondary fill inside a window: sidebars, sections. Light: one warm step under white. Proposed, Desk Light.

surface-3.$description: Menus and raised rows. Light: warm, two steps under white. Proposed, Desk Light.

surface-4.$description: Hover fill of buttons and rows. Light: warm, the hover fill of a row or button. Proposed, Desk Light.

surface-5.$description: Active and pressed fill of buttons and rows. Light: the darkest surface, so the darkest backdrop glass is tested over. Proposed, Desk Light.

overlay-solid.$description: Foreground overlay scale, solid end (white on dark, ink on light). Light: the desk ink. Proposed, Desk Light.

overlay-5.$description: Foreground overlay scale: a translucent wash over any surface. Light: the desk ink at 5%, neutral like the white overlays of dark. Proposed, Desk Light.

overlay-10.$description: Foreground overlay scale: a translucent wash over any surface. Light: the desk ink at 10%, neutral like the white overlays of dark. Proposed, Desk Light.

overlay-20.$description: Foreground overlay scale: a translucent wash over any surface. Light: the desk ink at 20%, neutral like the white overlays of dark. Proposed, Desk Light.

overlay-30.$description: Foreground overlay scale: a translucent wash over any surface. Light: the desk ink at 30%, neutral like the white overlays of dark. Proposed, Desk Light.

overlay-40.$description: Foreground overlay scale: a translucent wash over any surface. Light: the desk ink at 40%, neutral like the white overlays of dark. Proposed, Desk Light.

overlay-50.$description: Foreground overlay scale: a translucent wash over any surface. Light: the desk ink at 50%, neutral like the white overlays of dark. Proposed, Desk Light.

overlay-80.$description: Foreground overlay scale: a translucent wash over any surface. Light: the desk ink at 80%, neutral like the white overlays of dark. Proposed, Desk Light.

overlay-90.$description: Foreground overlay scale: a translucent wash over any surface. Light: the desk ink at 90%, neutral like the white overlays of dark. Proposed, Desk Light.

scrim-solid.$description: Scrim scale: black at a fixed alpha in both schemes, for shadows and backdrops. Same as Desk dark. Proposed, Desk Light.

scrim-10.$description: Scrim scale: black at a fixed alpha in both schemes, for shadows and backdrops. Same as Desk dark. Proposed, Desk Light.

scrim-20.$description: Scrim scale: black at a fixed alpha in both schemes, for shadows and backdrops. Same as Desk dark. Proposed, Desk Light.

scrim-30.$description: Scrim scale: black at a fixed alpha in both schemes, for shadows and backdrops. Same as Desk dark. Proposed, Desk Light.

scrim-40.$description: Scrim scale: black at a fixed alpha in both schemes, for shadows and backdrops. Same as Desk dark. Proposed, Desk Light.

scrim-50.$description: Scrim scale: black at a fixed alpha in both schemes, for shadows and backdrops. Same as Desk dark. Proposed, Desk Light.

scrim-60.$description: Scrim scale: black at a fixed alpha in both schemes, for shadows and backdrops. Same as Desk dark. Proposed, Desk Light.

scrim-70.$description: Scrim scale: black at a fixed alpha in both schemes, for shadows and backdrops. Same as Desk dark. Proposed, Desk Light.

scrim-80.$description: Scrim scale: black at a fixed alpha in both schemes, for shadows and backdrops. Same as Desk dark. Proposed, Desk Light.

scrim-90.$description: Scrim scale: black at a fixed alpha in both schemes, for shadows and backdrops. Same as Desk dark. Proposed, Desk Light.

scrim.$description: Modal scrim under a dialog or a window that opens over the page. Light: 36% instead of 65%. A light page needs less to recede; the window over it stays the brightest thing on screen. Proposed, Desk Light.

inverse.$description: Inverse fill: a dark chip on light, a light chip on dark. Same as Desk dark. Proposed, Desk Light.

glass.$description: Window glass, drawn with the window blur and saturate. Light: white at 72% (dark: #1f1f1f at 53%). Lighter than the desk, as dark glass is lighter than the black desk. Over the darkest backdrop (surface-5) it lands at #f5f4f3, over white at white, so every text tone holds 4.5:1 at both ends. Proposed, Desk Light.

glass-strong.$description: Dense glass: toasts, notifications, menus. Light: near white at 88%, the same alpha as dark. Proposed, Desk Light.

glass-clear.$description: Clear glass: only for bars over pictures. Light: near white at 36%. Clear glass is only for bars over pictures. Proposed, Desk Light.

glass-tinted.$description: Glass tinted by the yellow primary at low strength. Light: a cream of the yellow primary at 66%, the same strength as the regular glass. Proposed, Desk Light.

glass-solid.$description: Glass under reduced transparency or more contrast: a solid surface. Light: the glass over the desk, made opaque. Proposed, Desk Light.

glass-flat.$description: Window glass without a live blur (no real GPU). Light: as light as the blurred glass over the desk, opaque enough that the grain does not show through. Proposed, Desk Light.

glass-edge.$description: Divider inside glass, for example under a title bar. Light: black at 6% (dark: white at 7%). Proposed, Desk Light.

glass-border.$description: Edge of a glass panel: toasts, notifications, menus. Light: black at 10% (dark: white at 12%). Proposed, Desk Light.

glass-hover.$description: Hover wash of a row or a menu bar item on glass. Light: black at 4.5% (dark: white at 6%). Proposed, Desk Light.

titlebar.$description: Title bar band over the window glass. Light: white at 32%, so the title bar is a touch lighter than the glass, as in dark (white at 3%). Proposed, Desk Light.

menubar.$description: Menu bar at the top of the desk. Light: the desk tone lifted to near white at 72%, the same alpha as the black menu bar of dark. Proposed, Desk Light.

dock.$description: Dock at the bottom of the desk. Light: near white at 62% (dark: #1c1c1c at 65%). Proposed, Desk Light.

subtle.$description: Decorative hairline; a control boundary uses border.control. Light: warm, decorative hairlines only. Proposed, Desk Light.

muted.$description: Quiet divider. Light: warm. Proposed, Desk Light.

default.$description: Default divider and card edge. Light: warm. Proposed, Desk Light.

strong.$description: Strong divider. Light: warm. Proposed, Desk Light.

control.$description: Boundary of an input or a control (SC 1.4.11). A11y: 3:1 or more on body to surface-3 and on flat glass (measured 3.51:1 at worst, on the desk). Proposed, Desk Light.

control-hover.$description: Input border under the pointer. Light: the desk ink at 70%. Proposed, Desk Light.

hairline.$description: The window hairline inside the shadow. Light: black at 10% (dark: white at 10%). Proposed, Desk Light.

bright.$description: Headings, the second line of a two tone heading, titles. Light: a neutral ink, warm by a hair to sit on the warm desk. Dark uses pure white. Proposed, Desk Light.

default.$description: Body and label text. Light: neutral ink, a step softer than bright, as #ededed is in dark. Proposed, Desk Light.

muted.$description: Secondary text. Light: 4.5:1 or more on body to surface-3 and on glass over both backdrops (5.75:1 on the desk). Proposed, Desk Light.

subtle.$description: Captions and meta. A11y: the lightest tone that keeps 4.5:1 on the desk (4.63:1) and on glass over the darkest backdrop. Proposed, Desk Light.

disabled.$description: Disabled controls only. Light: disabled controls only (exempt from SC 1.4.3). Never for placeholders. Proposed, Desk Light.

placeholder.$description: Input placeholder: the subtle tone, 4.5:1 (never the disabled tone). Same as Desk dark. Proposed, Desk Light.

link.$description: Links stay achromatic and are always underlined (SC 1.4.1). Same as Desk dark. Proposed, Desk Light.

on-primary.$description: Text and icons on a primary fill. Same as Desk dark. Proposed, Desk Light.

on-accent.$description: Text on an accent fill. Light: white on a deep accent fill (dark: ink on a pastel fill). Proposed, Desk Light.

dim.$description: Grey first line of a two tone heading. Light: the grey first line of a two tone heading. Closer to bright than muted, as #b9b9b9 is in dark. 4.5:1 or more on glass and body to surface-3. Proposed, Desk Light.

fill.$description: Yellow primary fill (owner decision 2026-10-11). The yellow stays the same in both schemes. On light it is only 1.38:1 on white and 1.06:1 on the desk, so primary.border carries SC 1.4.11. Proposed, Desk Light.

fill-hover.$description: Primary fill under the pointer. Light: hover goes one step deeper (dark goes one step lighter), so the step reads against a light page. Proposed, Desk Light.

fill-pressed.$description: Primary fill while pressed. Light: pressed goes deeper again. Proposed, Desk Light.

text.$description: Text and icons on the primary fill. The dark text on yellow stays: 10.79:1 or more on every fill step. Proposed, Desk Light.

border.$description: Primary button boundary. A11y addition: a 1px dark gold edge that reaches 3:1 on body to surface-3 (3.35:1 on the desk, 4.34:1 on white, 3.14:1 against the yellow itself). The lightest gold that passes, so the yellow still leads. Open choice in docs/reports/desk-light.md: #7a5c00 (5:1) for a firmer edge. Proposed, Desk Light.

tint.$description: Soft fill of the yellow primary (emphasis soft). Light: the yellow at 24% (dark: 12%), so the soft fill still reads as yellow on white. Proposed, Desk Light.

tint-hover.$description: Soft primary fill under the pointer. Light: the yellow at 36% (dark: 20%). Proposed, Desk Light.

on-surface.$description: The primary as text and icon colour on a surface. A11y change: the yellow fails as text on light, so a deep gold of the same hue carries text and icons: 4.5:1 or more on body to surface-3 and on the yellow tints. Proposed, Desk Light.

1.$description: Identity accent (categorical). Light: the deep tone of the mint accent: 4.5:1 or more as text on surface-2, and white text holds 4.5:1 on it. Proposed, Desk Light.

2.$description: Identity accent (categorical). Light: the deep tone of the lavender accent: 4.5:1 or more as text on surface-2, and white text holds 4.5:1 on it. Proposed, Desk Light.

7.$description: Identity accent (categorical). Light: the deep tone of the yellow accent: 4.5:1 or more as text on surface-2, and white text holds 4.5:1 on it. Proposed, Desk Light.

9.$description: Identity accent (categorical). Light: the deep tone of the fuchsia accent: 4.5:1 or more as text on surface-2, and white text holds 4.5:1 on it. Proposed, Desk Light.

10.$description: Identity accent (categorical). Light: the deep tone of the red accent: 4.5:1 or more as text on surface-2, and white text holds 4.5:1 on it. Proposed, Desk Light.

fill.$description: danger icon, badge and outline colour. Light: a deep red that reaches 3:1 on body to surface-2. Proposed, Desk Light.

text.$description: danger text on a plain surface. A11y: danger text holds 4.5:1 on body to surface-3. Proposed, Desk Light.

border.$description: danger border. Light: 3:1 or more on body to surface-2. Proposed, Desk Light.

tint-10.$description: danger tint for alerts and chips. Light: the state hue at 10%. Proposed, Desk Light.

tint-20.$description: danger tint under the pointer. Light: the state hue at 20%. Proposed, Desk Light.

on-tint.$description: danger text on its tint (alerts, chips). A11y: 4.5:1 or more on both tints over body to surface-2. Proposed, Desk Light.

solid.$description: danger solid button fill. Light: a deep tone with white text (dark: a light tone with ink text). Proposed, Desk Light.

solid-hover.$description: danger solid button fill under the pointer. Light: one step deeper on hover. Proposed, Desk Light.

on-solid.$description: Text and icons on the danger solid fill. Light: white, 4.5:1 or more on solid and solid-hover. Proposed, Desk Light.

fill.$description: warning icon, badge and outline colour. Light: a deep amber that reaches 3:1 on body to surface-2. Proposed, Desk Light.

text.$description: warning text on a plain surface. A11y: warning text holds 4.5:1 on body to surface-3. Proposed, Desk Light.

border.$description: warning border. Light: 3:1 or more on body to surface-2. Proposed, Desk Light.

tint-10.$description: warning tint for alerts and chips. Light: the state hue at 10%. Proposed, Desk Light.

tint-20.$description: warning tint under the pointer. Light: the state hue at 20%. Proposed, Desk Light.

on-tint.$description: warning text on its tint (alerts, chips). A11y: 4.5:1 or more on both tints over body to surface-2. Proposed, Desk Light.

solid.$description: warning solid button fill. Light: a deep tone with white text (dark: a light tone with ink text). Proposed, Desk Light.

solid-hover.$description: warning solid button fill under the pointer. Light: one step deeper on hover. Proposed, Desk Light.

on-solid.$description: Text and icons on the warning solid fill. Light: white, 4.5:1 or more on solid and solid-hover. Proposed, Desk Light.

fill.$description: success icon, badge and outline colour. Light: a deep emerald that reaches 3:1 on body to surface-2. Proposed, Desk Light.

text.$description: success text on a plain surface. A11y: success text holds 4.5:1 on body to surface-3. Proposed, Desk Light.

border.$description: success border. Light: 3:1 or more on body to surface-2. Proposed, Desk Light.

tint-10.$description: success tint for alerts and chips. Light: the state hue at 10%. Proposed, Desk Light.

tint-20.$description: success tint under the pointer. Light: the state hue at 20%. Proposed, Desk Light.

on-tint.$description: success text on its tint (alerts, chips). A11y: 4.5:1 or more on both tints over body to surface-2. Proposed, Desk Light.

solid.$description: success solid button fill. Light: a deep tone with white text (dark: a light tone with ink text). Proposed, Desk Light.

solid-hover.$description: success solid button fill under the pointer. Light: one step deeper on hover. Proposed, Desk Light.

on-solid.$description: Text and icons on the success solid fill. Light: white, 4.5:1 or more on solid and solid-hover. Proposed, Desk Light.

solid.$description: info solid button fill. Light: a deep tone with white text (dark: a light tone with ink text). Proposed, Desk Light.

solid-hover.$description: info solid button fill under the pointer. Light: one step deeper on hover. Proposed, Desk Light.

on-solid.$description: Text and icons on the info solid fill. Light: white, 4.5:1 or more on solid and solid-hover. Proposed, Desk Light.

fill.$description: info icon, badge and outline colour. Light: a deep violet, the hue of the dark info (#a78bfa); the first pass used indigo that reaches 3:1 on body to surface-2. Proposed, Desk Light.

text.$description: info text on a plain surface. A11y: info text holds 4.5:1 on body to surface-3. Proposed, Desk Light.

border.$description: info border. Light: 3:1 or more on body to surface-2. Proposed, Desk Light.

tint-10.$description: info tint for alerts and chips. Light: the state hue at 10%. Proposed, Desk Light.

tint-20.$description: info tint under the pointer. Light: the state hue at 20%. Proposed, Desk Light.

on-tint.$description: info text on its tint (alerts, chips). A11y: 4.5:1 or more on both tints over body to surface-2. Proposed, Desk Light.

ring.$description: Focus ring (SC 2.4.7, 1.4.11). Light: a 2px ink ring (dark: near white). 3:1 or more on every surface, on glass and on the halo. Proposed, Desk Light.

halo.$description: Halo between an item and its ring, for focus over pictures. Light: white, so the ink ring reads over pictures and dark fills. Proposed, Desk Light.

ring-on-primary-inner.$description: Inner ring of the doubled focus ring on the yellow primary. Light: the ink ring sits on the yellow (11.4:1 or more against the fill) and on the surface. Proposed, Desk Light.

ring-on-primary-outer.$description: Outer ring of the doubled focus ring on the yellow primary. Light: a white outer ring, so the doubled ring still shows as two rings on the grey desk. Proposed, Desk Light.

light-close.$description: Close light. A11y change: a touch deeper than the mac red (#ff5f57, 2.99:1 on white) so the light reaches 3:1 on a white title bar. Proposed, Desk Light.

light-min.$description: Minimize light. A11y change: the mac yellow (#febc2e) is 1.69:1 on white; this amber of the same hue reaches 3:1. Open choice in the report. Proposed, Desk Light.

light-zoom.$description: Zoom light. A11y change: the mac green (#28c840) is 2.23:1 on white; a deeper green of the same hue reaches 3:1. Proposed, Desk Light.

light-ink.$description: Glyph inside a light on hover and focus. A11y change: a little darker than dark (#4d0000 at 70%) so the glyph keeps 3:1 on the deeper lights. Proposed, Desk Light.

light-idle.$description: The lights at rest: plain dots. A11y change: the idle dots reach 3:1 on a white title bar (dark: near white dots on dark glass). Proposed, Desk Light.

selection.$description: Selection ring on the canvas. Neon green stays in both schemes; on light the ink halo (canvas.selection.halo) carries 3:1. Proposed, Desk Light.

hover.$description: Hover ring on the canvas. Light: the dark magenta darkened just enough for 3:1 on surface and surface-2. Proposed, Desk Light.

selector.$description: Selector affinity ring. Light: the dark orange darkened just enough for 3:1 on surface and surface-2. Proposed, Desk Light.

guide.$description: Snap guide on the canvas. Light: the dark cyan darkened just enough for 3:1 on surface and surface-2. Proposed, Desk Light.

placeholder.$description: Base tint of the empty module placeholder. Light: text subtle at 4%. Proposed, Desk Light.

axis.$description: Chart axis line. Light: the strong border tone. Proposed, Desk Light.

grid.$description: Chart grid line. Light: surface-4, quiet. Proposed, Desk Light.

on-light.$description: Label ink on a light chart fill. Light: the desk ink. Proposed, Desk Light.

stripe.$description: Stripe colour of the empty module placeholder. Light: text subtle at 6%. Proposed, Desk Light.

shadow.$description: Shadow under floating canvas chrome. Light: a soft cool shadow. Proposed, Desk Light.

bg.$description: The board fill. Same as Desk dark. Proposed, Desk Light.

edge.$description: Section frame edge, 3:1 against the board and the section. Light: 50% for 3:1 against white. Proposed, Desk Light.

dot.$description: Board dot grid. Decorative only. Same as Desk dark. Proposed, Desk Light.

halo.$description: Halo around the selection ring. A11y addition: neon green is about 1.3:1 on light, so a 1px ink halo carries the 3:1. Proposed, Desk Light.

fill.$description: Marquee fill. Light: neon green at 18% (dark: 12%). Proposed, Desk Light.

border.$description: Marquee border. Light: ink, since neon green fails 3:1 on light. Proposed, Desk Light.

text.$description: Text on a neon green badge. Same as Desk dark. Proposed, Desk Light.

fill.$description: Resize handle fill. Same as Desk dark. Proposed, Desk Light.

border.$description: Resize handle edge. Light: ink: the white handle and the green edge both fail 3:1 on light. Proposed, Desk Light.

ring.$description: Ring around a note on the board. Light: ink (white fails on a light canvas). Proposed, Desk Light.

xs.$description: Chips, badges, keycaps, swatch dots. Same as Desk dark. Proposed, Desk Light.

sm.$description: Editor controls, tooltips, frame corners. Same as Desk dark. Proposed, Desk Light.

panel.$description: Floating panels, dialogs, toasts, spotlight. Same as Desk dark. Proposed, Desk Light.

card.$description: Tile cards, context menus, canvas top-start corner, notch. Same as Desk dark. Proposed, Desk Light.

control.$description: Pill inputs and sm/md/lg buttons. Same as Desk dark. Proposed, Desk Light.

window.$description: Desk windows. Same as Desk dark. Proposed, Desk Light.

sheet.$description: Sheets take the window corner. Same as Desk dark. Proposed, Desk Light.

pill.$description: Pills. Same as Desk dark. Proposed, Desk Light.

radius.$description: Corner of a menu item. Same as Desk dark. Proposed, Desk Light.

panel.$description: Panel: an inset bottom edge, then a drop shadow. Light: the same shape as dark with a cool ink at a fraction of the strength. Proposed, Desk Light.

menu.$description: Alias of a window shadow. Same as Desk dark. Proposed, Desk Light.

dialog.$description: Alias of a window shadow. Same as Desk dark. Proposed, Desk Light.

tooltip.$description: Tooltip shadow. Light: a cool drop and a white top highlight. Proposed, Desk Light.

card-hover.$description: Card lift on hover. Light: cool ink, soft. Proposed, Desk Light.

input-focus.$description: Inner glow of a focused input. Light: an inner shade, a white inner light and a soft cool glow. Proposed, Desk Light.

card.$description: Cards are flat tiles: no shadow at rest. Same as Desk dark. Proposed, Desk Light.

window.$description: Shadow under a desk window. Light: the dark shape (30px down, 80px blur) in a cool ink at 26%, then a 1px ring at 6%. Softer, so a window floats without a dark halo on the light desk. Proposed, Desk Light.

window-soft.$description: Soft window shadow: menus, toasts. Light: cool ink at 22% (dark: black at 80%). Proposed, Desk Light.

glass.$description: Shadow under a glass panel. Light: cool ink, the dark shape at a third of the strength. Proposed, Desk Light.

panel.$description: Backdrop blur of a glass layer. Same as Desk dark. Proposed, Desk Light.

backdrop.$description: Blur behind a window that opens over the page. Same as Desk dark. Proposed, Desk Light.
